reason: Implemented GTM read, diff and staging tools, but gtm_list_workspaces forwards encoded continuation cursors directly to Google, breaking subsequent paginated reads.
exposure: All 28 tools captured: 20 default read tools and 8 opt-in write tools. Write mode via --enable-write or GMCP_ENABLE_WRITE=1/true/yes/on. No publishing, deletes, approval/review tokens or per-call confirm gate. Version preview is read-only snapshot. Default row cap is 25, configurable by GMCP_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT; hard cap 100000, GSC search cap 25000.
limitations: Offline registry construction from compiled source, matching the tools/list projection; no protocol request or Google tool handler was executed. Google endpoint behavior and credential scopes were not remotely verified.
gtm_list_workspaces sends input.pageToken directly to Google instead of upstreamPageToken, while pageRows returns gmcp-prefixed cursors.
Schemas preserved exactly as registered; runtime validations and defaults can exceed schema constraints (path normalization, date/filter checks, row caps and server configuration).

tools.name: ga4_create_custom_dimension
tools.description: CHANGES CONFIGURATION. Creates a custom dimension on a GA4 property. NOT REVERSIBLE: GA4 custom dimensions can only be ARCHIVED, never deleted, and this server does not implement archiving. Slots are limited (typically 50 event-scoped and 25 user-scoped per property) and archiving can free quota but cannot be undone. Do NOT create dimensions speculatively — confirm with the user that the parameter is actually being collected and that they want it registered. Note that creating a dimension does not start data collection; your tagging must already send the parameter, and data only appears going forward, never retroactively.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property ID. Call ga4_list_account_summaries to discover it.

scope.description: EVENT for event parameters, USER for user properties, ITEM for ecommerce item parameters. Cannot be changed after creation.

disallowAdsPersonalization.description: USER-scoped only. Marks the dimension as NPA (no ads personalization).

REVERSIBLE: the tag exists only in the workspace and affects no live site until a version is created and explicitly published. Delete it from the GTM UI, or discard the workspace changes. tools.name: gtm_update_tag
tools.description: CHANGES A WORKSPACE. Updates a tag, MERGING your changes over its current configuration. REVERSIBLE: workspace-only until published, and GTM keeps version history. Fields you omit are PRESERVED — this server fetches the current tag and merges, because the raw GTM API replaces instead, which silently clears omitted fields. (Verified: omitting firingTriggerId on the raw API empties it, leaving a tag that looks normal in the GTM UI but never fires.) To deliberately CLEAR a field, pass it explicitly as an empty array — e.g. firingTriggerId: [] unwires the tag from all triggers. Omission preserves; explicit empty clears. `parameter` is merged by key, so you can change one parameter without resending the rest. Requires the full tag path from gtm_list_tags.

tagPath.description: Full tag path 'accounts/{a}/containers/{c}/workspaces/{w}/tags/{id}'. Get it from gtm_list_tags.

type.description: GTM tag type code. Required by the API on update.

parameter.description: GTM parameter array: [{ type: 'template'|'boolean'|'integer'|'list'|'map', key: string, value: string }]. For a Custom HTML tag use [{ type: 'template', key: 'html', value: '<script>...</script>' }].

tools.behavior: Reads and merges a workspace tag, preserves omitted fields, merges parameters by key, and updates with the current fingerprint.
